headline: Hormuz tensions push diesel cracks to extremes, NJ refinery labor dispute erupts
intro: Diesel is doing its best impression of a rocket again, and this time it's dragging crude, cracks, and your heating bill along for the ride. Meanwhile, a labor standoff just hit a key East Coast refinery — because apparently fuel markets needed one more variable.
overview: Crude and diesel both surged to five-month highs as Iranian attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and Houthi threats to Saudi infrastructure rattled markets, with diesel cracks near $111/bbl reflecting acute distillate tightness. On the policy front, Trump confirmed a diesel-focused deal with Russia tied to sanctions relief, while the administration also unveiled an $8B biofuel relief program for the 2026 crop year. Operationally, Phillips 66's Bayway refinery and Linden terminal saw union workers locked out after contract expiration, adding a domestic supply-chain risk just as refiners like Citgo report surging margins.

stories.title: Brent Hits a Five-Month High on Gulf Attacks, and Diesel Drivers Feel It First
stories.summary: Brent hit $111.05/bbl, the highest since May, as Reuters reported continued Gulf shipping attacks; WTI traded near $104.80.

stories.title: Oil Soars to 5-Month Highs on Mounting Supply Risks
stories.summary: Oil futures rose to five-month highs as Iranian attacks on commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz intensified alongside lingering Houthi threats to Saudi infrastructure.

stories.title: Diesel's Breakout Signals Renewed Pressure Across Energy Markets
stories.summary: Diesel futures led the energy complex higher, reversing more than 23 cents/gallon off Monday's lows, while RBOB and crude also gained amid broader strength.

stories.title: Prolonged Hormuz Blockade Triggers Cost Shock, Eroding Profits Across Asian Refining, Aviation and Shipping
stories.summary: Prolonged Hormuz blockade is eroding profits across Asian refining, aviation, and shipping even as widening petroleum product cracks offer some offset.

stories.title: Oil Prices Mixed on U.S. Sanctions Waivers, Hormuz Threats
stories.summary: Oil futures ended mixed Monday as WTI rallied over 2% on a U.S. sanctions waiver for Russian goods while Brent edged lower.

stories.title: Trump Says Diesel Deal Aims to Keep Russia Talks Going
stories.summary: Trump said he struck a diesel export deal with Russia and delayed further sanctions to keep Putin engaged in peace talks.

stories.title: US waives Russia sanctions as Gulf oil shipments face renewed disruption
stories.summary: Trump signed an executive order waiving key sanctions and tariffs on Russian oil and gas for 60 days amid renewed Gulf shipment disruptions.

stories.title: Union employees locked out of New Jersey oil refineries after contracts expire
stories.summary: Union-represented workers were locked out of Phillips 66's Bayway Refinery and Linden Terminal in New Jersey after labor contracts expired.

stories.title: Citgo Raises Profit Outlook by $2B
stories.summary: Citgo Petroleum raised its 2026 operating profit outlook by $2 billion, citing surging fuel margins, according to a document seen by Bloomberg.

stories.title: How Much Additional Diesel Could Reach the Market?
stories.summary: Rigzone examines how much additional diesel supply could reach the market and what that would mean for prices amid the current squeeze.

stories.title: Trump administration announces $8 billion Harvest Fuel Relief program
stories.summary: The Trump administration announced an $8 billion Harvest Fuel Relief program providing proportional support to biofuel producers for modeled 2026 crop-year losses.

stories.title: September RIN generation eases, but 2026 biofuel volumes stay ahead of last year
stories.summary: EPA data show September RIN generation eased slightly year-on-year, but 2026 biofuel volumes remain ahead of last year across most fuel categories.

stories.title: Fuel prices push heat costs in Mid Atlantic, New England much higher
stories.summary: Heating oil costs in the Mid-Atlantic and New England have jumped sharply year-over-year, per EIA data, as fuel prices squeeze residential heating budgets.

stories.title: Hybrid sales rise while battery electric sales remain lower after tax credit expiration
stories.summary: EIA reports hybrid vehicle sales grew to 16% of light-duty sales in 3Q26 even as overall electrified-vehicle share slipped slightly amid rising new-vehicle prices.
